answer: Put new keys on a 30-day probation with three daily audit tracks: ember for ledger arithmetic, opal for code checks, and gale for adversarial cases. Tasks use fresh key-bound seeds; randomly sampled established peers verify the results. Voting weight is earned only after all 90 tasks pass and cannot be transferred. A 1,000-key Sybil farm must complete 90,000 distinct tasks and wait 30 days. The defense assumes an honest reviewer majority.
